title: PARACHUTE vs. HUL:The 13-YEAR WAR That Changed INDIAN Business Forever

👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:

Doston, 1991 ek aisa saal tha jisne Indian business ki history ko hamesha ke liye badal diya! India ne 'Liberalization' se apne darwaze khole aur entry maari FMCG duniya ke sabse bade 'Don' Hindustan Unilever ne!! Tabhi HUL ka market mein sirf ek hi rule tha: "Buy or Bury" (ya toh woh aapki company kharid lete, ya phir aapke saath compete karke aapka market share kha jaate).
Aur 1991 mein HUL ki nazar thi ek mamooli si neeli bottle par, jiska naam tha Parachute Coconut Oil. In dono companies mein itna farak tha ki jahaan Marico sirf 100 crore ki revenue par thi, globally HUL hazaaron crore kama raha tha, jisse woh India mein kabhi bhi koi brand kharid sakta tha!! Bade-bade actors, Hollywood se lekar Bollywood tak, Unilever ke brands ko endorse karte the, aur HUL 75 countries mein already ek dominating player ban chuka tha.

Tabhi HUL ke chairman ne Parachute ke founder, Harsh Mariwala, ko call kiya aur bola, “Harsh, ye company hume bech do. Main tumhe itna paisa dunga ki tumhari aage wali pushten bhi aish karegi!!” Toh sabko laga tha ki HUL ki money power ke aage ye choti si Indian company ghutne tek degi. Lekin doston, Parachute ne aisa masterstroke khela ki 13 saal ki jung ke baad, HUL ne khud har maarke apna brand Marico ko bech diya!!

Toh sawaal ye hai: Ek choti si Indian company ne duniya ke sabse bade FMCG giant ko unhi ke game mein kaise haraya?  Wo kaunsi business strategy thi jisse Harsh Mariwala ne HUL ke karodon ke budget ka samna kiya? Aur is business war se hum kya business lesson seekh sakte hain? Ye sab janenge is episode mein!!
